# Atom File Icons browser adapter

This directory vendors the browser adapter for [file-icons/atom](https://github.com/file-icons/atom).

- Adapter: `websemantics/file-icons-js`
- Revision: `8b397223dc14fa57600f1b06c787dfd2107c4449`
- Atom source referenced by the adapter: `file-icons/atom`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.md`

The JavaScript database, CSS, and font files are copied without semantic changes. The DSH build scopes the CSS selectors to Shikitor file-icon elements and embeds the font files into the client bundle.
